comparisons.peer_topic: Other Income (Expense), Net Composition and Results
comparisons.peer_summary: Other income (expense), net totaled $181 million in 2024, down from $197 million in 2023, primarily due to decreased interest income from lower short-term investment balances; this line item is primarily comprised of interest income from short-term investments, changes in valuation of equity investments, and foreign currency transaction gains and losses.
comparisons.comparison: Both AMD and NVDA disclose the composition of 'Other, net' or 'Other income (expense), net' as comprising gains/losses from investments and foreign currency impacts. However, AMD provides specific quantitative details for 2024, reporting $181 million and attributing the year-over-year decrease from $197 million primarily to lower interest income from short-term investment balances. In contrast, NVDA's disclosure is qualitative, stating that the change compared to fiscal year 2023 was driven by valuation changes in non-affiliated investments without providing a total dollar amount or breaking out interest income as a distinct primary driver in this section.
